title: Would You Still Love Me If Questions

prompts.prompt: Would you still love me if I waved enthusiastically at a stranger because I thought it was you?
Would you still love me if I made a birthday invitation for our pet every year?
Would you still love me if I packed three backup outfits for every weekend trip?
Would you still love me if I sang the same song every time I cooked dinner?
Would you still love me if I needed subtitles for every movie, including ones in my own language?
Would you still love me if I turned every relaxed weekend into a color-coded itinerary?
Would you still love me if I refused to replace our collection of mismatched mugs?
Would you still love me if I fell asleep before the ending of almost every show we started?
Would you still love me if I told the same favorite story at every gathering?
Would you still love me if I wanted to rearrange the furniture at midnight?
Would you still love me if I gave every houseplant a name and a detailed personality?
Would you still love me if I wore socks with sandals on every vacation?
Would you still love me if I cried at every animated movie trailer?
Would you still love me if I insisted on arriving at the airport three hours early?
Would you still love me if I wanted an annual matching-costume photo tradition?
